Garvis AI
item.content:encoded:
<p>Lately, the pattern for building "AI Apps" has been mostly the same: spin up a UI, drop in an OpenAI API key, and call it a day. While powerful, this approach left me wanting to build something robust, private, and entirely local.</p>
<p>So, I built Garvis AI — an offline Windows desktop assistant heavily inspired by Iron Man's J.A.R.V.I.S., capable of understanding natural language and dynamically generating 51 different Pygame games on demand.</p>
